caption: This drawing depicts a ceramic figurine of a seated dog placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The dog has a predominantly light cream-colored body with brown patches on the ears, side, and tail, as well as additional brown markings on the legs and base. The ears are droopy, colored solid brown, and the dog has large, round eyes with prominent black pupils. The nose is black, and the mouth is outlined in red. The figurine wears a red collar with a green tag hanging from it. The base on which the dog sits is oval and decorated with alternating brown and cream-colored segments. The drawing is rendered with attention to detail, showing the texture and patterns of the dog's fur and the ceramic glaze. No additional objects or backgrounds are visible.
title: Prince Charles Spaniel
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
